reuse.why: Every site that computed the ranged amount itself (forecast, schedule template, action sync, posting, preview) now calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount.

duplication.why: Removes five inline copies of the midpoint rule and leaves the range rule in a single function.

placement.why: The rule changes in shared/schedules.ts, the module that already exported the amount helper used by client and server.

scope.why: Only the helper, its call sites, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Future changes to the expected-amount rule now land in one well-tested function used everywhere.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No call site computes the ranged amount outside getScheduledAmount after the change.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are removed, not reshaped.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount; forecast-schedules normalizeSchedule, schedule-template createScheduleList, schedules/app updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions all call it.
